diagnostics.message: Two-group MGA v2 reports Group A/Group B structural paths, R-squared values, outer loadings, outer weights, and A-minus-B differences. Inference uses deterministic two-tailed group-label permutation and is paired with MICOM v2 measurement-invariance assessment.
Two-group permutation MGA v2 re-estimates path coefficients, outer loadings, and outer weights after every deterministic group-label permutation and reports two-tailed A-minus-B evidence.

MICOM v2 evaluates computational configural prerequisites, compositional invariance, and equality of pooled-score means and variances. Translation, coding meaning, and substantive indicator equivalence still require researcher review.
